name: B10-0333/2026 – Recital J – Am 6
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the impact of the Turkish invasion on Cypriot women and girls, and the crimes committed by Turkish forces and consequences on gender equality
part_text: J. whereas it was noted during the FEMM Committee mission to Cyprus that there is ongoing engagement with a broad range of societal actors, including religious institutions, civil society organisations, community groups and other stakeholders, contributing to the recognition of past crimes, reconciliation, and healing of past traumas, with respect for distinct cultural identities and the promotion of dialogue in the context of the ongoing status quo in Cyprus, following the events of 1974 that resulted in the occupation of the island and with a view to achieving a comprehensive, just and viable solution on the agreed basis; whereas it was further highlighted during the mission that these actors demonstrate the capacity to respond with sensitivity and pragmatism in periods of acute social upheaval, including through their commitment to promoting gender equality;
